hook.text: Each foot has 26 bones, 33 joints, and over 100 muscles and tendons. It's an engineering marvel.

buildup.text: The arch distributes weight across the foot. Without it, every step would send a shock to your spine.

discovery.text: The heel bone, the calcaneus, is the largest foot bone. It absorbs the initial impact of every stride.

twist.text: Flat feet aren't always a problem. Many people function fine without a visible arch.

climax.text: Your feet walk roughly 100,000 miles in a lifetime. That's four trips around the Earth on 52 bones.

punchline.text: 26 bones per foot. 100,000 miles per life.

quiz.question: What is the primary role of the foot's arch?
options: To distribute weight and absorb shock
